name: 14354-imagechat-qwen3vl4b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration: a 24-layer vision tower (patch 16, 2x2 spatial merge) in front of a 36-layer text decoder; 4B dense, FP8 e4m3 weights, ~5 GB on disk.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm over `/v1/chat/completions`, SINGLE TURN: one shared 500-token preamble (`prefix_count: 1`), 600 tokens of per-request text, and one 1280x720 JPEG (quality 85, gradient content, byte-distinct per request), asking for 230 output tokens with `ignore_eos`. About 1980 tokens in, 230 out.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering single-turn questions about uploaded photos for 128 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang server arguments: one H100 serving a 4B FP8 vision-language model over the OpenAI
# chat endpoint, 128 requests in flight. Flat `key: value` only.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-FP8
tp-size: 1

enable-multimodal: true
mm-attention-backend: sdpa

# A request is ~2240 tokens (500 shared prefix + 600 prompt text + 880 image + template + 230
# generated) and guidellm's text-token accounting is approximate, so the ceiling is set above
# it: an overshoot is a REJECTED request rather than a slow one. KV is nowhere near binding.
context-length: 3072

cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
page-size: 16

mem-fraction-static: 0.7
kv-cache-dtype: fp8_e4m3

enable-torch-compile: true
torch-compile-max-bs: 128

stream-interval: 300
